market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite both closed lower. This decline was influenced by Nvidia's stock sinking after its earnings report, dragging down other tech companies. Additionally, general market uncertainty stemming from recent widespread tech outages contributed to a cautious investment environment.

vix.why: The VIX, a measure of market volatility, increased. This rise occurred amid concerns over widespread tech outages, which analysts noted were fueling "apocalyptic concerns" and panic buying, indicative of increased market fear and uncertainty.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate saw a modest decrease in the latest weekly Freddie Mac survey, which was released on November 12, 2026. This movement tracks a general direction of lower Treasury yields over the recent days leading up to the survey period.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Temporary regulations were issued concerning a new nonrefundable Federal tax credit for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations.
policy_upcoming.effect: A new nonrefundable Federal tax credit becomes available for qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations in 2027 and later taxable years.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: FHFA conforming loan limit for next year — expected late November
policy_calendar.note: The cap on a conforming (non-jumbo) mortgage, and the line between a normal rate and a jumbo one. FHFA has announced it in the last days of November each year, and the new limit applies to loans made from January 1.

tech.summary: Waymo has temporarily suspended its autonomous freeway driving operations following a complaint regarding its robotaxis entering a construction zone in California.
Shelly has launched a new smart valve designed to be installed on a home's main water line, which can automatically shut off water flow if a connected leak sensor detects a problem.
Will Wright, creator of games like SimCity and The Sims, is developing a new game called MyMems that utilizes artificial intelligence to map and explore players' memories.

world.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping, and Russian President Vladimir Putin engaged in handshakes and prepared for historic talks at the APEC summit in China.
Five European Union nations are exploring plans to deport rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda as part of a new approach to managing migrant flows.
Russian attacks across Ukraine resulted in the deaths of at least five people, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy describing the strikes on Odesa as 'brutal'.
Canada's Prime Minister accused Russian leader Vladimir Putin of 'lying' for downplaying the impact of Western sanctions, as international tensions persist.

us.summary: Democrats formally nominated Hakeem Jeffries to become the first Black House speaker, a significant step toward him leading the chamber when the new Congress begins next year.

A bipartisan group of US senators has urged Jay Clayton, the national intelligence and AI czar, to identify and address vulnerabilities in AI systems following recent mass outages that affected critical infrastructure.
Cal-Maine, the largest egg producer in the United States, announced plans to cull 1.8 million birds at a Florida site due to an outbreak of avian influenza, affecting 2.7 percent of its total flock.

science.summary: The Pan American Health Organization announced that the United States has officially lost its measles elimination status, classifying the disease as endemic due to a strain persisting for over a year.
An international effort by brain researchers has created a cellular atlas of the basal ganglia, laying groundwork for improved treatments for neurological conditions like dementia.
